In Sunset City, sunny weather now transitions into overcast skies, and after rain, fog settles over the city. Combined with the changing time of day, this makes the city feel even more alive and realistic, while gameplay becomes more immersive and varied.

Different weather conditions are also accompanied by visual changes: raindrops can be seen on the car’s body, and puddles remain on the roads, reflecting the city’s neon glow.
